title: Peak, fall, magnitude

members.role: a dashed ring lands on the peak as the climb reaches it and holds (E56: a ring on a chart circles a datum)
on the fall's verb the line draws on from the peak to the trough
a light runs the fall from the peak to the trough, its comet head leading, as the size of the fall is said
the fall's size is written at the trough, in neg ink below the point, as the light arrives - the page's own arithmetic

does: The peak is ringed as the line reaches it, the crash draws on its verb, a light runs the fall, and the drop's size lands at the trough as the light arrives.

use_when.act: TURNS - a series read down to one number, the size of its fall (BRAVOS-USE-WHEN R18)
use_when.shape: series -> one number: a line with a clear prior peak and the trough it fell to, both on the page
use_when.use: a sentence that names a crash and its size ('then crashed by nearly two-thirds'): ring the peak, light the fall, land the % at the trough
use_when.dont: the fall is not spoken as a number (the guide's don't); the % the voice says is not the page's own arithmetic (E77 - write the object's, -64%, never the treatment's -66)

source: P71 T34 (harvest v2 R18; STK 0:12-0:18, HIS 05:58-06:02, BOOM 14:16-14:23 per VERIFY.md); proved as a private test-bed beat by projects/_proofs/p71-recipes/proof_t34.py on Steel and Paper H row 9 ('Railways in the 1840s ... then crashed by nearly two-thirds', take 70.94 s) on ev-railway-index-v1 - no approved cut carries it
